s.note: the Baroness's black and white ball
s.how: Top blinis with creme fraiche and a little black lumpfish roe. Dip strawberries halfway in melted white chocolate and set on baking paper. Lay both out on black trays in strict rows, black and white only.

Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, rinse and dry. Fry at 140C until soft, rest, then fry at 190C until crisp. Tip into paper and shake over plenty of malt vinegar and salt. Eat on the street in 1970s London.

m.how: Sear a 1kg beef eye fillet all over and brush with Dijon. Cook 400g chopped mushrooms until dry. Lay prosciutto on plastic wrap, spread with the mushrooms, roll around the beef and chill. Wrap in puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.how: Beat 200g butter with 200g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 40g cocoa. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Split each layer and fill with cream whipped with melted white chocolate. Chill and slice to show the stripes.

d.note: the red dress that bursts out of the burning cape at the ball
d.how: Steep 2 tbsp dried hibiscus flowers in 300ml boiling water for 10 minutes, then strain. Simmer with 125g raspberries and 80g caster sugar for 5 minutes, mash and strain again, then chill. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 60ml syrup and the juice of a quarter lime to each, then top with sparkling water. Garnish with raspberries.
